1: // Simple Asteroid Dodger game
2: // Canvas element with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   // Sound assets (provide your own files in the same directory)
9:   const sounds = {
10:     thrust: new Audio('thrust.wav'), // ship movement
11:     explode: new Audio('explosion.wav'), // collision
12:     bgm: new Audio('bgm.mp3') // background music
13:   };
14:   sounds.bgm.loop = true;
15:   sounds.bgm.volume = 0.3;
16:   sounds.bgm.play().catch(() => {}); // autoplay may be blocked
17: 
18:   // Set canvas size to match its displayed size
19:   const resize = () => {
20:     canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
21:     canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
22:   };
23:   resize();
24:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
25: 
26:   // Player configuration – spaceship triangle
27:   const player = {
28:     width: 30,
29:     height: 15,
30:     x: canvas.width / 2,
31:     y: canvas.height - 30,
32:     speed: 5,
33:     moveLeft: false,
34:     moveRight: false,
35:     draw() {
36:       const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(this.x - this.width / 2, this.y, this.x + this.width / 2, this.y + this.height);
37:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#00ffff');
38:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#0066ff');
39:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
40:       ctx.beginPath();
41:       ctx.moveTo(this.x, this.y);
42:       ctx.lineTo(this.x - this.width / 2, this.y + this.height);
43:       ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.width / 2, this.y + this.height);
44:       ctx.closePath();
45:       ctx.fill();
46:     },
47:     update() {
48:       if (this.moveLeft) this.x -= this.speed;
49:       if (this.moveRight) this.x += this.speed;
50:       // Keep within bounds
51:       const half = this.width / 2;
52:       this.x = Math.max(half, Math.min(canvas.width - half, this.x));
53:     }
54:   };
55: 
56:   // Input handling
57:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
58:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a') {
59:       player.moveLeft = true;
60:       sounds.thrust.currentTime = 0;
61:       sounds.thrust.play();
62:     }
63:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd') {
64:       player.moveRight = true;
65:       sounds.thrust.currentTime = 0;
66:       sounds.thrust.play();
67:     }
68:   });
69:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
70:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a') player.moveLeft = false;
71:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd') player.moveRight = false;
72:     // Stop thrust sound when no movement keys pressed
73:     if (!player.moveLeft && !player.moveRight) {
74:       sounds.thrust.pause();
75:       sounds.thrust.currentTime = 0;
76:     }
77:   });
78: 
79:   // Asteroid management
80:   const asteroids = [];
81:   const spawnInterval = 1000; // ms
82:   let lastSpawn = 0;
83: 
84:   // Starfield background
85:   const stars = [];
86:   const starCount = 100;
87:   for (let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
88:     stars.push({
89:       x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
90:       y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
91:       radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5
92:     });
93:   }
94:   const drawStars = () => {
95:     ctx.fillStyle = 'black';
96:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
97:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
98:     for (const s of stars) {
99:       ctx.beginPath();
100:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
101:       ctx.fill();
102:     }
103:   };
104: 
105:   const spawnAsteroid = () => {
106:     const radius = 15;
107:     const x = Math.random() * (canvas.width - 2 * radius) + radius;
108:     const speed = 2 + Math.random() * 2; // 2-4
109:     asteroids.push({ x, y: -radius, radius, speed });
110:   };
111: 
112:   const updateAsteroids = (delta) => {
113:     for (let a of asteroids) a.y += a.speed;
114:     // Remove off‑screen
115:     while (asteroids.length && asteroids[0].y - asteroids[0].radius > canvas.height) {
116:       asteroids.shift();
117:     }
118:   };
119: 
120:   const drawAsteroids = () => {
121:     for (let a of asteroids) {
122:       const gradient = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.radius * 0.2, a.x, a.y, a.radius);
123:       gradient.addColorStop(0, '#ff9966'); // bright core
124:       gradient.addColorStop(1, '#663300'); // outer
125:       ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
126:       ctx.beginPath();
127:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
128:       ctx.fill();
129:     }
130:   };
131: 
132:   const checkCollision = () => {
133:     for (let a of asteroids) {
134:       const dx = a.x - player.x;
135:       const dy = a.y - (player.y + player.height / 2);
136:       const distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
137:       if (distance < a.radius + Math.max(player.width, player.height) / 2) {
138:         return true;
139:       }
140:     }
141:     return false;
142:   };
143: 
144:   let gameOver = false;
145:   let lastTime = 0;
146:   const loop = (timestamp) => {
147:     if (!lastTime) lastTime = timestamp;
148:     const delta = timestamp - lastTime;
149:     lastTime = timestamp;
150: 
151:     drawStars();
152: 
153:     // Spawn asteroids
154:     if (timestamp - lastSpawn > spawnInterval) {
155:       spawnAsteroid();
156:       lastSpawn = timestamp;
157:     }
158: 
159:     player.update();
160:     player.draw();
161: 
162:     updateAsteroids(delta);
163:     drawAsteroids();
164: 
165:     if (checkCollision()) {
166:       gameOver = true;
167:       sounds.explode.currentTime = 0;
168:       sounds.explode.play().catch(() => {});
169:     }
170: 
171:     if (gameOver) {
172:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
173:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
174:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
175:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
176:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
177:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
178:     } else {
179:       requestAnimationFrame(loop);
180:     }
181:   };
182: 
183:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
184: })();
